1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 15 m de altura, con corteza lisa de color gris, madera liviana y poco resistente, raíces colgando de las ramas, hojas alternas, enteras y brillantes y flores casi imperceptibles, de las que sale un fruto parecido al higo. (Moraceae; Ficus dendrocida)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 15 m, with smooth gray bark, light and relatively weak wood, hanging roots from the branches, alternate, entire, and shiny leaves, and almost imperceptible flowers from which emerges a fruit similar to a fig. (Moraceae; Ficus dendrocida)
